notification_test_cases.scenario: MCP notification with valid patient and encounter context
notification_test_cases.expected_result: A Generated codes notification card is displayed.
Clicking the notification opens the existing ambulatory coding canvas.

notification_test_cases.scenario: Notification is missing patient or encounter context
notification_test_cases.expected_result: The notification does not open the canvas. The MCP logs notification_context_incomplete.

notification_test_cases.scenario: Generated codes card or canvas cannot display details
notification_test_cases.expected_result: The conversational response does not expose codes, code counts, or code types and says: Unable to display generated codes. Please try again later.
No recode tool call and no new notification card or canvas are generated. The response directs the user to click Recode in the existing Generated codes canvas.
